params.1273: Level your Attack and Defence skills to 5.
params.1274: To gain Attack experience, fight in Accurate combat style.
params.1275: To gain Defence experience, fight in Defensive combat style.
params.1276: Certain quests also give Attack and Defence experience as rewards.
params.2225: At 5 Attack you can wield steel weapons, and at 5 Defence you can wear steel armour.
